messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: GPU node gpu-elk-17 in dedicated pool 'elixirnet-prod-pool' entering ECC error state. Automatic drain started. Affected tenants: elixirnet-prod (pinned models), fallback routing enabled.
oncall-sre (Matt): I'm on it. Paging hw-team and infra. Matt taking first responder. ETA to confirm health 5m.
SRE - Priya: saw the same. KV-cache eviction in flight for tenant elixirnet-prod; some in-flight requests may 502. Is traffic already routed to fallback model-quantized-1?
incident-bot: Routing policy triggered: elixirnet-prod -> model-quantized-1 (fallback) in us-east-1. Burst queue activated. No API key anomalies detected.
Infra Ops - Jorge: checking node: ssh to gpu-elk-17 shows ECC interrupts and PCIe resets. Looks like sustained ECC. Marking for replacement. Jorge starting graceful drain: running `redwoodctl node drain gpu-elk-17 --timeout 300s --force-fallback`.
SRE - Priya: coordinating customer-facing messaging. @AE - Nina can we notify ElixirNet support channel? Minimal impact but degraded tail latency for large-context calls.
AE - Nina: @ElixirNet - Elena I'm drafting a note. Will send in 10m. Keep me posted on failover stability.
SE - Emma: For mitigation, recommend spinning up one hot spare in elixirnet-prod-pool and increasing prefix cache TTLs to reduce regen. Command to add capacity:
```
redwoodctl pool scale elixirnet-prod-pool --add 1 --instance-type a5000
```
This will take ~2-3m to pass health checks.
ElixirNet - Elena: Thanks for the heads up. We're seeing a few slow responses in our staging logs but not 5xx yet. Keep us posted.
oncall-sre (Matt): hw-team, want us to proceed with immediate replacement or try soft-reset first? Jorge suggests node has persistent ECC.
hw-team: soft-reset completed, errors reappeared after 30s. Recommend replace. Raising RMA with cloud provider. Also grant Jorge access to isolate local NVMe logs.
Infra Ops - Jorge: started cordon/drain procedure: `kubectl cordon gpu-elk-17` then `kubectl drain gpu-elk-17 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data`. Monitoring pod reschedules. Current evictions: 12 pods, 8 belong to elixirnet-prod tenant.
SRE - Priya: Handoff note: Matt -> Priya for next 30m during replacement. Matt: please update incident checklist and set priority to P2 if customer impact stays limited to latency.
oncall-sre (Matt): handing off. Priya taking command. :white_check_mark:
SRE - Priya: All evicted pods are hitting fallback models gracefully. We're seeing increased token cost but service remains available. Keeping traffic routed to fallback while replacement completes. ETA for replacement from hw-team 18m.
cloud-provider-bot: RMA submitted (RMA#CLOUD-7891). Spot instance termination not involved (on-demand pool). Expected replacement node in 16-20m.
SRE - Priya: action items: (1) keep ElixirNet notified, (2) scale +1 hot spare if reschedules lag >120s, (3) monitor error rate and latency tail. I'll post another update in 10m or on change.
AE - Nina: Sent initial note to customer Slack with summary and mitigation steps. They asked for per-request logs if errors appear; Emma please prepare a scoped log export for elixirnet-prod for the window 14:05-14:25.
SE - Emma: on it, pulling logs and will redact PII. `rdw-log export --tenant elixirnet-prod --from 2026-03-12T14:05Z --to 2026-03-12T14:25Z --out elixirnet-drain.log`
SRE - Priya: update 10m: drain complete, node cordoned, pods rescheduled to pool nodes. Latency spike subsided to +40ms p50, p99 still elevated by ~220ms. Replacement in progress.
oncall-sre (Matt): thanks team. If p99 doesn't improve after replacement, we'll consider temporary traffic shedding for large-context calls for this tenant.
ElixirNet - Elena: Appreciate the transparency. Please tag any customer billable impact separately. We'll prepare a support ticket if errors spike.
SRE - Priya: noted. Logging incident as INC-20260312-ELX-42 and linking to customer ticket. Closing update for now; will reopen thread when replacement completes or if customer impact increases.
incident-bot: Incident INC-20260312-ELX-42 created and assigned to SRE - Priya. Timeline & artifacts: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-20260312-ELX-42
